This tool I built makes it easy to work on multiple projects at the same time.
(ghostty + tmux).
Personally, it has proven really useful in viewing every terminal window at the same time (OVERVIEW), including claude code sessions and/or other terminal windows, for localhost or for git commands.

author: mcpherrinm
text: No: An attacker can massively distribute the key cracking effort, and do it offline.  That is so many orders of magnitude faster than asking an sshd if the password is correct, even with the flaw discussed here where it isn't rate limited.  Without that flaw, you have to start a new TCP connection every three guesses, which is glacially slow compared to cracking the passphrase to decrypt the key.
